title: FastAPI dependencies, async work, and tests

spans.text: Dependency injection separates reusable authentication, database sessions, and configuration from endpoint logic. async def helps only when the libraries provide asynchronous I/O; blocking code still stalls the event loop. Use TestClient to verify requests, responses, validation errors, and status codes, then select an ASGI server and worker count for deployment.

spans.code:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.post('/items', json={'name': 'pen', 'price': 1.5})
assert response.status_code == 200
No console output; the assertion passes when POST /items returns HTTP 200.

spans.text: TestClient checks HTTP behavior without opening a network port.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: A synchronous database call can block inside an async endpoint; use a suitable async driver or separate worker.

spans.title: Warning
spans.text: Do not expose the development server; review production proxy and secret configuration separately.
